login.title: Sign in to the supplier portal
login.intro: Type the e-mail this organization has on record. We will send a sign-in link, usable once, to that address.
login.sent: If this e-mail is on record, a sign-in link will arrive within a few minutes. Please check your inbox.

link.title: Confirm your sign-in
link.intro: Press the button to get a six-digit code by e-mail. This link works once.

otp.title: Enter your code
otp.intro: We sent a six-digit code to your e-mail. It works for 10 minutes, on this device only.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.2026-11-01: This organization keeps the names, e-mails, phone numbers and documents you send through the portal to register suppliers, to contact you about purchases and payments, and for checks the law requires. They are kept for the period the organization sets and shown only to those whose work needs them. You may ask its procurement team for a copy, a correction or deletion of your data.
privacy.2026-11-08:
This organization keeps the names, e-mails, phone numbers and documents you send through the portal to register suppliers, to assess supplier risk, to contact you about purchases and payments, and for checks the law requires. They are kept for the period the organization sets and shown only to those whose work needs them.

Evidence files of a risk questionnaire that you mark as holding no personal data and readable by the AI assistant are sent to an outside AI provider to draft answers for you to check. Files you do not mark are never sent.

You may ask its procurement team for a copy, a correction or deletion of your data.

list.intro: The assessments this organization's procurement team sent your company to answer. Those you can still answer are at the top.

assessment.notFound: This assessment was not found. The link may be wrong, or the assessment is not your company's.
assessment.intro: Choose the answer that fits your company for each question, then press the save button at the end of the page. You can save and come back later. When every question is answered, press the send button.
assessment.readOnly: This assessment was sent or is closed. You can see the answers but not change them.
assessment.missingMark: This question still needs an answer or a confirmation before you send.
assessment.fromEvidence: This answer comes from a certificate procurement has checked. You cannot change it, but you can confirm it.

assessment.saveHint: This button saves the answers and notes of every question on this page.

assessment.missingTitle: Questions that still need an answer or a confirmation

assessment.sent: The assessment is sent. Thank you. If anything needs changing, procurement will return it to you.
